svg.title: Fuck This, I Need a Nap — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A stocky raccoon with rounded ears, black eye mask, pale muzzle, five-toed paw, and a bushy ringed tail, curled under a blanket. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
